metadata.homeDescription: Manage your Teleb Furniture store from the dashboard.

dashboard.description: You can now add components and start building.

products.title: Products
products.listDescription: Browse and manage the furniture products in your catalog. Create products, update their details, and keep your store information organized in one place.
products.emptyDescription: Add your first product to start building the catalog.
products.formDescription: Add a clear name and description for this product. These details help your team identify and manage products in the catalog.

collections.title: Collections
collections.listDescription: Group related products into collections to keep your catalog easy to browse. Create collections and update their details as your product range changes.
collections.emptyDescription: Add a collection to organize related products.
collections.formDescription: Choose a clear collection name and describe which products it represents. This helps keep related items organized in your catalog.

banners.title: Banners
banners.listDescription: Manage the banners customers see in your store. Create and update banner information to keep featured content current.
banners.emptyDescription: Add a banner to feature content in your store.
banners.formDescription: Add a recognizable name and a short description for this banner so your team can identify its purpose.

offers.title: Offers
offers.listDescription: Review and manage the promotional offers available in your store. Create offers and update their information as promotions change.
offers.emptyDescription: Add an offer to promote products in your store.
offers.formDescription: Give this offer a clear name and describe its purpose so it is easy to recognize and manage.

messages.title: Messages
messages.listDescription: Review messages sent by your customers and keep track of incoming questions or feedback in one place.

login.title: Sign In to Your Teleb Furniture Account
login.description: Sign in to your Teleb Furniture account to access your dashboard, manage your furniture products, and manage your account securely.
